slot.brief: First pair maps a word/letter set to a numeric code using letter positional values combined with rearrangement of letters; candidate must decode the hidden two-step rule and apply it to a new word at highest difficulty.

stem: In a letter-number code, CLOUD is written as 21151243. By the same rule, how is TRACE written?

verdicts.working: CLOUD has letter positions 3, 12, 15, 21, 4; arranging them in descending order gives 21, 15, 12, 4, 3. TRACE gives 20, 18, 1, 3, 5, which in descending order is 20, 18, 5, 3, 1 = 2018531.

working:
Arrange the letters in reverse alphabetical order, then replace each by its A1Z26 value: CLOUD → UOLDC → 21|15|12|4|3. TRACE → TRECA → 20|18|5|3|1 = 2018531.

Independent check: CLOUD has letter positions 3, 12, 15, 21, 4; arranging them in descending order gives 21, 15, 12, 4, 3. TRACE gives 20, 18, 1, 3, 5, which in descending order is 20, 18, 5, 3, 1 = 2018531.
solution:
Arrange the letters in descending alphabetical order and write their A1Z26 values consecutively.
$$\text{TRACE} \to \text{TRECA} \to 20|18|5|3|1 = 2018531$$
